patch.value: Fail closed when repository configuration exists but cannot be read

Discovered during served-repository adversarial testing: engine/config.ts readConfig catches every readFileSync error and returns DEFAULT_CONFIG. A repository whose .pmvcs/config.json has been replaced by a directory therefore advertises an empty record configuration rather than refusing. Distinguish absence from unreadable or invalid filesystem shape, preserve older repositories without a config file, and add FileTransport and HTTP parity tests. This is a pre-existing configuration-reader behavior; the HTTP feature records it as a separate follow-up.
